title: 宝塚記念の後に・暗影

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following a magnificent display, the glory of the Takarazuka Kinen goes to Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The venue is awash with cheers for a performance befitting her title of Otherworldly Front-Runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing the excitement of the crowd, Air Groove is struck painfully by the feeling she can't surpass Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her composure rattled, Air Groove puts on a brave face to focus on the Sapporo Kinen ahead, but nonetheless leaves the racecourse dejected.
